MI-280 U18 — arm the landing route for claude/mi280-backlog-date-accessor.

The PATH is the signal; these contents are for a human reading the diff.

Tier 1, landing: self. One owner for "when was this backlog row opened?" —
scripts/ops/_backlog.py::row_date, with three never-collapsed states, plus
the removal of a collapsed state in backlog_drain_candidates._added_after
(a definite negative for a row whose date was never established).

PR #11981 was opened BY THIS SESSION before this file was pushed, so it
carries a real pull_request event and CI fired normally. That ordering is
deliberate: claude-pr-automerge adopts an existing open PR rather than
creating one, and a PR the workflow opens itself is born with no
pull_request event and exactly one check run.

⚠️ NOTHING ELSE GOES ON THIS BRANCH AFTER THIS PUSH. A commit pushed while
CI runs on the previous head can miss the squash entirely — auto-merge
takes the PR the moment the earlier head goes green.
